adapter_source_findings.finding: Native result record ends the persistent plain turn; no timed poll/settlement delay. Native-config snapshot runs before the first provider request.
Native agent_settled ends the persistent RPC turn; no timed poll/settlement delay.
Grok finite CLI must reach stdout/stderr EOF and checked process exit before result; pumpjoin/procwait have no fixed sleep. Original and candidate Grok/Pi adapters and sharedbase are byteidentical.

conclusion: Within this retained n4/n8 comparison, concurrency4 passes and concurrency8 misses for all three default mock profiles. This audit does not set the current global passing ceiling and does not include intermediate-rung trials. Resource/call-gap evidence supports substantial concurrency CPU cost but cannot establish all possible optimizations exhausted.
limitations: Only3serialcontrol samples per phase; nearest-rankp95 of3 is max. No claim of a population percentile.
No per-thread runnable status, per-process thread count, PSI, or native CPU stacks retained. Aggregate thread totals cannot assign work to a pool.
Tool-event→next-request includes official execution/bookkeeping, scheduler, transport, providertracer; not a direct measurement of toolCPUtime.
Cold and warm phase cgroupwindows overlap across sessions, so phase averages are shared-process-tree observations, not isolated perturnCPU.
Mockmain4calls+3tools are equal; Grokauxiliary requests/cancellations remain counted. No real inference speed claim.
Pool-size observations are outside this retained n4/n8 data set. This audit itself launched no workload and modified no measured profile or production source.

semantics.causal_limit: No new native instrumentation. Inter-event gaps combine official runtime/tool execution/scheduling/transport and cannot prove a specific internal bottleneck.
semantics.cpu_pressure: Runnable counts and PSI were not sampled; thread count is not runnable count. Near-four-core occupancy and quota throttle deltas are observed indicators only.
semantics.fixture_processing: Per-request handler plus response delivery wall time, outside workload cgroup; auxiliary work is retained.
semantics.phase_boundary: Earliest correlated request arrival to hmz result; includes native auxiliary calls. Call-gap split uses observed hmz tool events, not native tool CPU boundaries.
semantics.phase_cpu_summary_weighting: Every reported phase_cpu value is the unweighted arithmetic mean of the three per-rung values. Each per-rung average interpolates cgroup counter deltas only across the observed resource-sample intervals intersecting the union of phase windows. Unsampled leading/trailing intervals contribute neither CPU nor duration. Rungs with different sampled-window durations receive equal summary weight.
semantics.resource_windows: Whole cgroup/process tree. Cold and warm stages overlap across sessions; phase windows are unions and not additive. CPU integrals interpolate the retained approximately 0.2-second counter intervals.
